faq: Q: Do you sell whole beans? A: Yes, we sell 12oz bags of our house blend and rotating single-origins.
Q: Is there parking? A: The Downtown location has street parking. Westside has a small lot in the back.
Q: Do you cater? A: We offer coffee carafes and pastry boxes for local offices. Requires 24h notice.
